status: Discovery-ready hypothesis; fictional buyer scenario; not approved or sold
buyer: US independent industrial supply distributors using NetSuite, initially with an existing Celigo account and repeated emailed purchase orders
problem: Staff retype customer purchase orders and resolve product, quantity, price and delivery-address mismatches before orders can move to fulfilment.
outcome: Process more orders with the existing team; reduce manual handling while retaining staff approval.
offer: We turn emailed purchase orders into checked sales-order drafts inside your existing workflow, so your team can handle more orders without more retyping.
scope: One shared mailbox and one NetSuite subsidiary
Up to five recurring customer document families, selected for volume
Staff approval and an exception queue; no autonomous fulfilment
Training, runbook, baseline and pilot result report
timeline: Six-week implementation planning assumption after access and technical sign-off, followed by a 30-day measured pilot.
proposed_guarantee: Reduce median staff handling time by 30% on the agreed order cohort in the first 30 live days, or continue the agreed optimisation work without a management fee until achieved. Proposed, conditional on baseline and technical approval.
pricing_status: Internal commercial hypothesis only; main proposal is an unsigned concept with fees to agree.
software_status: Vendor pricing and IDP/ERP entitlements require an account-specific quote. $600 is a sensitivity assumption, not a quoted tier.
